map.勾选各项合规检查项，系统自动评估资质完备度、法规符合度、检查通过率，给出合规等级: Check each compliance item, and the system automatically evaluates qualification completeness, regulatory compliance and inspection pass rate, giving a compliance grade and remediation advice.
map.📖 查看「宠物经营合规检查 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pet Business Compliance Check User Guide"
map.按资质完备度、法规符合度、检查通过率三组加权评估：各组得分率 = 该组已达标项权: Weighted evaluation by three groups (qualification completeness, regulatory compliance, inspection pass rate): each group's score rate = sum of weights of its met items ÷ total group weight × 100%; composite score = sum of each group's score rate × its weight; a pass rate ≥90% is grade A, 75%–89% B, 60%–74% C, below 60% D (must remediate); unmet items are listed by remediation priority in descending weight.
map.通风/温湿度控制达标: Ventilation / temperature-humidity control up to standard
map.资质证照为硬性要求，缺失将直接影响合规判定: Qualification certificates are hard requirements; missing them directly affects the compliance judgement
map.动物诊疗许可证仅诊疗机构需要，其他类型可跳过: The animal diagnosis/treatment license is needed only for clinics; other types can skip it
map.各检查项按权重计分，总分100分: Each inspection item is scored by weight; total 100 points
map.合规等级：≥90分优秀，75-89良好，60-74一般，<60不合格: Compliance grade: ≥90 excellent, 75–89 good, 60–74 fair, <60 fail
map.📚 深度解析：宠物经营合规检查: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Pet Business Compliance Check
map.宠物店/犬舍/猫舍开业或年审前，逐项勾选资质证照、法规符合与日常检查项，快速得到: Before opening or for annual review of a pet shop / kennel / cattery, check each qualification, regulatory and daily-inspection item to quickly get the compliance total score and grade.
map.连锁门店做巡店自检，用统一权重（资质40%/法规35%/检查25%）横向对比各店: For chain stores doing store self-checks, use unified weights (qualification 40% / regulation 35% / inspection 25%) to compare compliance across stores.
map.整改跟踪：先补齐缺失的资质项（硬性 85% 门槛），再提升法规与日常检查通过率，: Remediation tracking: first fill the missing qualification items (hard 85% threshold), then raise regulatory and daily-inspection pass rates, reaching standard step by step.
map.资质齐备（完备度 100%→40 分）、法规符合 80%（→28 分）、日常检查: Qualifications complete (completeness 100% → 40 pts), regulation 80% (→28 pts), daily 70% (→17.5 pts): composite = 40+28+17.5 = 85.5 → 86 pts, judged 'compliant-good'. If qualification completeness is below 85%, regardless of total score it is directly judged 'fail (missing qualification)'.
map.为什么资质不全会直接不合格？: Why does incomplete qualification directly fail?
map.资质证照（营业执照、动物防疫条件合格证等）是经营前置硬条件，工具把资质权重设 4: Qualification certificates (business license, animal-epidemic-prevention certificate, etc.) are preconditions for operation. The tool sets qualification weight 40% with an 85% hard threshold; below it is judged fail, avoiding the 'high score but no license' compliance illusion.
map.综合分怎么算？: How is the composite score computed?
map.综合分 = 资质完备度×40 + 法规符合度×35 + 检查通过率×25（各率均: Composite = qualification completeness × 40 + regulatory compliance × 35 + inspection pass rate × 25 (each rate 0–1), rounded to integer; grades are excellent (≥90) / good (≥75) / fair (≥60) / fail.
map.宠物经营场所合规检查工具，覆盖资质证照、法规符合、日常检查三大维度共22项检查内: A pet business compliance-check tool covering three dimensions (qualification, regulation, daily inspection) with 22 items, supporting four business types (clinic / sales-breeding / grooming / boarding), auto-computing the compliance score and giving remediation advice.
map.四种经营类型自适应检查项: Four business types with adaptive check items
map.合规等级自动判定与整改建议: Auto compliance-grade judgement and remediation advice
